instruction: Triage this batch of customer support emails: assign each email to exactly one support category by its primary intent.

emails.subject: Access after role change
emails.body: post the role change i've lost visibility into the billing module — my peers can see it fine so it's not an outage, just need my entitlements reinstated

emails.subject: Still charged for removed seats
emails.body: we de-provisioned three seats last cycle and the app reflects it, but this statement still bills the old seat count — please true up the charge

emails.subject: Export: broken or intended?
emails.body: our CSV egress on large reports errors out every run — is that by design or a defect? for us it never completes

emails.subject: Wrong SKU sent
emails.body: you dispatched the wrong SKU; kindly ship the correct unit — we can reconcile the price delta afterwards, the priority is the right item

emails.subject: Totals look wrong
emails.body: our weekly aggregates looked off so we suspected a bug; turns out the figures are right, we just don't grok how your 'week' is bucketed — can you explain the rollup?
